notes: Bug fix: logging a plain ingredient that appears inside a saved dish's name (like 'carrot' in 'pasta with carrot tomato onion') wrongly logged the whole dish. The food matcher now only binds a dish when your word is its first or last word — an ingredient in the middle of a name can no longer pull in the whole dish. Bonus: 'oil' now finds Cooking oil instead of matching the word inside Chapati's description
